findings.body: `"café ".repeat(40)` creates a temporary `String`, and `.as_str()` borrows it. The temporary is dropped at the end of the statement, so the `&str` element in the array dangles, causing a compile error (E0716) in the test module. Store the repeated `String` in a variable before the loop (or use a `&'static str` if possible) and pass its `as_str()`.
findings.title: Store the repeated string in a variable to avoid a temporary borrow

findings.body: `shorten`'s doc comment says it returns text of at most `limit` characters, but when no space is found in the first `limit` characters, this arm returns `limit + 1` characters (`head` plus the ellipsis). A caller relying on the limit (e.g., GitHub's title ceiling) could still exceed it. Truncate to `limit - 1` characters before appending the ellipsis, and handle `limit == 0` early.
findings.title: Keep the shortened string within the stated limit

findings.body: The repository rule requires every file to open with a module doc that describes its role and feature gating. This doc explains the role but does not say whether the module is gated behind a feature; add that information (or explicitly state that there is no feature gating).
findings.existing_code: //! Shortening model-authored text for the places that have a length limit.
findings.title: Mention feature gating in the module doc

value.summary: The module adds truncation helpers with tests, but the test uses a reference to a temporary that will not compile, and `shorten` can exceed its stated limit when no space is found; the module doc also omits feature gating. Not safe to merge until these are fixed.
